title: Free & Legal Backcountry Camping North of the Catskills: Resupply and Services
trail_mile_note: Miles are measured along the mapped trail from the Schoharie Creek bridge in Gilboa. walk_miles_from_trail is the road distance from the nearest point of the trail, rounded.

check_values.almanac_verified: A Mohawk Valley or Hudson Valley Almanac listing exists and was checked on the date shown. That confirms the business, not this season's hours.
check_values.listing_only: An almanac listing exists but has not been verified.
check_values.source_official: Hours come from the USPS locator. They change, especially around holidays.
check_values.book_researched: Researched for the book from official or business sources; not on the almanac.
check_values.unconfirmed: Listed somewhere, but not confirmed recently or at all. Call first.
check_values.owner_confirmed: Confirmed with the owner for this edition.
check_values.directory_listing: Listed in a local business directory (the Village of Middleburgh's, which dates from 2023, or an older regional one). Not confirmed recently, so call first.

stops.name: Gilboa Post Office
stops.note: Just before the Schoharie Creek bridge (NYNJTC Section 29 mile 1.6). A possible mail-drop for the first day.

stops.name: Sunken City Cider
stops.note: Cidery and orchard with a tasting bar; food trucks most weekends. Not a store. Hours are not listed.

stops.name: Catskill Mountains / Gilboa KOA
stops.note: The last store before Middleburgh. Camp store open to campers and the public. The trail passes the entrance and then takes a footpath above the campground (2024 reroute).

stops.name: Flock Ewe
stops.hours_text: Self-serve stand listed as open 24 hours
stops.note: Lamb, eggs, baked goods, maple syrup, and honey. About a 1 3/4-mile walk from the start. Confirmed with the owner.

stops.name: North Blenheim Post Office
stops.note: The only service on Day 1.

stops.group: West Fulton and the Route 30 valley (Sections 30-31)
stops.name: West Fulton Post Office
stops.address: West Fulton Rd, West Fulton, NY 12194
stops.note: ZIP 12194. A possible mail-drop before the long Patria stretch.

stops.group: West Fulton and the Route 30 valley (Sections 30-31)
stops.name: Sap Bush Hollow Farm
stops.address: 832 West Fulton Rd, West Fulton, NY 12194
stops.hours_text: Farm store open 24 hours (honor system); farm-to-table restaurant Saturdays 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.
stops.note: Organic eggs, turkey, local honey, and farm products. The best food stop before Middleburgh and it needs no schedule.

stops.group: West Fulton and the Route 30 valley (Sections 30-31)
stops.name: Barber's Farm
stops.hours_text: Tuesday to Sunday, 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.; closed Mondays
stops.note: Fruit, vegetables, and dairy. A fresh-food stop on the way into town.

stops.group: West Fulton and the Route 30 valley (Sections 30-31)
stops.name: Shaul Farms road stand and Fultonham Post Office
stops.note: Both appear on the map only.

stops.group: West Fulton and the Route 30 valley (Sections 30-31)
stops.name: Bohringer's Fruit Farm
stops.note: Pick-your-own and picked fruit in season. On the road the trail follows. Unconfirmed for this fall.

stops.group: West Fulton and the Route 30 valley (Sections 30-31)
stops.name: Scrumpy Ewe Cider
stops.address: 104 Fulton Hill Rd, West Fulton, NY 12194
stops.note: Farm cidery. Private tastings Friday 4 to 5 p.m. by appointment, per the almanac listing.

stops.name: Stewart's Shops, Middleburgh
stops.note: On the trail. Fuel is gasoline, not stove fuel. Ask inside whether you can fill up at the outside spigot, or buy bottled water. Treat spigot water as non-potable unless staff say otherwise.

stops.name: Middleburgh Post Office
stops.hours_text: Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. and 2:30 to 4:30 p.m.; Saturday 8:30 to 11:30 a.m.; closed Sunday
stops.note: On the trail. The natural General Delivery mail-drop. Call to confirm the hold time.

stops.name: Valley Market
stops.hours_text: 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday to Saturday; 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. Sunday
stops.note: The one full resupply. About 0.9 mile north of the village on NY 30.

stops.name: Middle Village Pasta & Grill
stops.note: Within a block or two of the trail.

stops.name: Forget Me Not Soda Shoppe
stops.note: Old-fashioned soda shop.

stops.name: Middleburgh Winery
stops.hours_text: Friday to Sunday, 12 to 5 p.m.; closed Monday to Thursday
stops.note: Tastings. About a 1 1/2-mile walk.

stops.name: Partridge Run Farm and Apiary
stops.note: Raw honey and beeswax. Near Fawn Lake. It could not be confirmed that they sell to walk-ins, so call ahead.

stops.name: Stewart's Shops, East Berne
stops.note: Coffee, food to go, snacks, fuel. About 1.3 miles from the trail crossing on NY 443 (2.6-mile round trip).

stops.name: Countryside Mobil and Dollar General
stops.note: Fuel and a Dollar General, 1.3 to 1.4 miles from the trail crossing.

stops.name: East Berne Post Office
stops.hours_text: Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to noon and 1 to 3 p.m.; Saturday 9 to 11 a.m.; closed Sunday
stops.note: About 1 3/4 miles from the trail. Use it only if you are already walking to Stewart's.

stops.name: Helderberg Tru Value hardware
stops.note: Might stock stove fuel canisters. Not confirmed: call before you count on it.

stops.name: Helderberg Mountain Brewing
stops.note: On Main St, East Berne. 1.6 to 1.7 miles from the trail.

stops.name: Helder~Herdwyck Farm
stops.note: Farm store with wool and meat. About a 1-mile walk.

stops.name: Stewart's Shops, Altamont (two locations)
stops.address: 2446 Western Ave and 1001 Altamont Blvd, Altamont, NY 12009
stops.note: On the trail. A finish-line meal and a ride out.

stops.name: Altamont village food and services
stops.note: A Sunoco, Village Pizza, Paisano's Pizza Villa, Bamboo Garden, Main St. Bakery and Cafe, Farmhouse Tap and Tavern, and the post office, all within a few blocks of the finish.

stops.name: Altamont Country Values (Agway)
stops.hours_text: Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Sunday 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
stops.note: Might stock stove fuel canisters. Not confirmed: call before you count on it.

stops.name: Altamont Orchards
stops.hours_text: Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.; weekends 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
stops.note: Apples, cider, vegetables, and bakery items. About a 1 3/4-mile walk from the finish.

stops.name: Mine Kill State Park
stops.address: Mine Kill State Park, NY 30, North Blenheim, NY
stops.hours_text: Restrooms and water when the park is open
stops.note: Day-use parking and the Long Path trailhead lot. Phone number is from an older county listing: ask whether the restrooms and water are on, and the dates.

stops.name: Max V. Shaul State Campground
stops.note: Fee campground. Ask about a hiker or walk-in site.

stops.name: Thompson's Lake Campground (Thacher State Park)
stops.address: 68 Thompsons Lake Rd, East Berne, NY 12059
stops.hours_text: Reserve through ReserveAmerica; about $17 to $21 a night for NY residents, $5 more for others, plus a reservation fee
stops.season_text: A-Loop opens May 1 and closes October 12; B-Loop opens May 22 and closed September 7 in 2026
stops.note: About 1 3/4 miles in a straight line from the nearest point of the trail, near mile 69. Ask how far the campground is from the trail by foot and whether the water is on.

stops.name: Altamont Old Stone House Inn
stops.note: The lodging the NYNJTC lists near the finish. Older directories name innkeepers who have since sold it, so the number may be stale.

stops.name: Middleburgh Diner
stops.note: At the south end of Main St, about 0.6 mile from the trail in a straight line. A hot meal you don't have to cook. Hours not confirmed.

stops.name: Hubie's Restaurant & Pizzeria
stops.note: On the trail, on Main St.

stops.name: Middleburgh Coffee Company
stops.note: On the trail, on Main St.

stops.name: Apple Food & Grocery (with Sunoco and Subway)
stops.note: A small grocery with a Sunoco gas station and a Subway. On the trail, on Main St.

stops.name: Middleburgh Pharmacy
stops.note: In the village, a short walk from Main St. Opened in 2018 per the village directory.

stops.name: Black Bear Country Inn
stops.note: An 1850 inn next to the post office. On the trail.

stops.name: Middleburgh Lanes & Laundromat
stops.note: Bowling alley, laundromat, and caterer, with leagues every evening. Could not confirm it is open now: call before you carry laundry there.

stops.name: Meadows Laundry
stops.note: In the Valley Plaza next to the Valley Market, about 0.9 mile north of the village. Could not confirm it is open now.

stops.name: Maple Inn
stops.note: Restaurant and bar in an old hotel, from an older regional directory. Call first.

stops.name: Maple on the Lake
stops.address: 141 Warners Lake Rd, East Berne, NY 12059
stops.note: At the address once listed as the Hofbrau. Farther out, so plan on a ride.
